generate.title: Generate onboarding tour
generate.body: DevDigest indexes the repo, then writes a 5-section guided tour: architecture, critical paths, local setup, reading order, and first tasks. Takes 30–60s and ~5,000 tokens.

banner.flag_off: Repo indexing is turned off — showing raw facts, not a written tour.
banner.index_failed: Indexing failed — showing raw facts, not a written tour.
banner.index_partial: Index degraded: partial — showing raw facts, not a written tour.
banner.repo_too_large: Repo is too large to fully index — showing raw facts, not a written tour.
banner.no_data: Not enough indexed data yet — showing raw facts, not a written tour.
banner.llm_call_failed: Couldn’t generate the tour this time — showing raw facts instead.
